text:
maria: quick RFC follow-up: we need a compact client-facing rollout metadata shape. goals: tiny payload, monotonic alias bindings, explicit retire hints, and clear cache guidance.
eli: agreed. proposing a minimal shape clients can fetch and cache. most fields optional to avoid coupling. sketch: 
```
{
  "epoch": "2026-03-15T00:00:00Z",
  "gen": 4,
  "source": "control-plane",
  "aliases": ["stable", "canary-a"],
  "soft_retire_ts": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z",
  "hard_retire_ts": "2026-04-15T00:00:00Z",
  "fallback_order": ["stable", "legacy"],
  "cache_ttl_s": 30,
  "models": ["m:text-3b@sha256:aa11"]
}
```
sara: key semantics we need to call out in the doc: gen is monotonic per-tenant and the primary signal for detect/rebind. aliases -> epoch binding must never decrease gen.
jon: soft_retire_ts should be advisory only. clients log warnings and prefer fallback; hard_retire_ts is a hard deny for alias resolves.
maria: cache_ttl_s default 30s with jitter; SDKs should backoff exponentially on metadata failures and respect cache until expiry. include example pseudocode.
eli: telemetry: emit alias_resolve{_ok,_miss,_fallback} and alias_rebind events including tenant_id+alias+gen. ops-bot: deploy-note: rollout-meta v2 deployed to canary at 4300000005
sara: security: metadata responses should be signed (sig:v1 header) for control-plane origin. SDKs must verify signature when present.
jon: ensemble support: models[] optional. core contract remains: client requests alias or epoch -> resolver returns epoch + metadata. clients only need epoch to pin.
maria: we should avoid surface that exposes full compat lists to clients; return compact compat_sig. admins can fetch full details from admin API.
eli: operational rule: enforce monotonic alias binds server-side for each tenant. rebinds are allowed only if gen increments.
sara: action items: (1) maria + eli update the draft with semantics and pseudocode. (2) ops to add telemetry + signing. (3) SDK team to implement cache TTL + backoff guidance.
jon: +1. keep schema intentionally tiny and optional to reduce client churn.
maria: if nobody objects, I'll merge the doc end of day and schedule a short canary with two Dedicated tenants next week.
eli: LGTM. thanks all.
